title: Tata Harrier BS6 2.0L Kryotec AT (2020): spoken safety rules
notes: Every number is an initial value chosen on reasoning, not measured on the car yet: tune them from real drives. A signal is only used while its definition is standard or verified.

signals.notes: Max ages: the DPF and exhaust are polled about twice a second, so 5 s tolerates a few lost replies; engine speed and speed are polled fast; coolant and AdBlue are slow-tier values read every few seconds.

egt.notes: PID 78, standard layer. Bank 1 sensor 1 only: the other EGT signals are not in this car's capture.

adblueLevel.notes: From the reductant controller, verified against the 2026-11-17 recording. The standard-layer def.reagent_level_pct is only inferred and must not be used here.

engine.notes: Initial value: below a typical cranking-to-idle speed, far under the ~800 rpm idle seen on the car.

dpf.notes: Soot figures are percent of the ECU's own soot scale. Initial values, tune on the car.

cooldown.notes: Initial values: 300 degC is where the exhaust is clearly hot at idle (about 140 degC) and below regeneration heat (above 300); two minutes idle is the usual turbo cool-down advice.

adblue.notes: Initial values: warn at a tenth of the tank so there is a few hundred km of margin, call it critical at 3 %.

coolant.notes: Initial values: normal running is about 90 degC; 110 degC is clearly past it.

alerts.notes: Initial values: critical alerts repeat every two minutes, warnings every quarter hour, the rest are spoken once.
